frame.placeholder_rule: blake2b body ID; Box-Muller x mean 0.5 SD 0.08, clipped [0.15,0.85]; uniform band y
frame.axis_rule: largest absolute median separation / pooled population SD; brain L/R then brain/VNC

source: MaleCNS v1.0 body annotations (Janelia FlyEM, CC BY 4.0): soma positions in the MaleCNS 8 nm voxel space, anterior view, aspect preserved; VNC somas below the brain; canvas axes ['x', 'z'], flip [True, False]; named sides: XLSX Root_Side; unpositioned neurons use an explicitly non-anatomical placeholder band
layout_note: 228 indexed neurons have no soma or entry point recorded in the MaleCNS v1.0 annotations (sensory neurons among them); they are drawn in a band below the brain outline and those positions are not anatomical. VNC somas are drawn in the strip at the bottom edge.
